parts.gloss: each time or as much as
each time or as much as

literal: Like seeing one's ignorance each time one learns, is love with the woman wearing beautiful jewels each time one unites closely.
translation: Just as learning more and more only reveals one's previous ignorance, so does drawing closer to this beautifully jeweled woman only reveal new, deeper dimensions of love.
modern: நூல்களைக் கற்கக் கற்க நம்முடைய அறியாமை விளங்குவது போல, சிறந்த அணிகலன்களை அணிந்த பெண்ணுடன் நெருங்கிப் பழகப் பழகக் காதல் இன்பம் மேலும் மேலும் புதியதாகத் தோன்றுகிறது.
explanation: This couplet compares the pursuit of knowledge with the experience of love. As a person learns more, they do not feel complete; instead, they realize how much they did not know before, exposing their own ignorance. Similarly, as the lover unites more closely with his beloved, he does not find satiation. Instead, each intimate union reveals new, previously unimagined depths of joy and desire, making him feel that his previous experience of love was incomplete.
